title: Kaizen daemon state
description: Single file at ~/.claude/.kaizen/data/daemon/state.json (v1.22.0+ path; previously ~/.claude/.kaizen-daemon/state.json). Producer + consumer: daemon.py tick / status. Tracks cron-driven hash-compare + hygiene runs.

last_run.description: ISO UTC of the most recent tick. Null before the first run.

source_hash.description: SHA1 of the plugin source dir at last tick. Used to detect source drift.

cache_hash.description: SHA1 of the cached version dir at last tick. Drift from source_hash triggers refresh-cache.

local_sha.description: git rev-parse HEAD of the marketplace at last tick.

remote_sha.description: ls-remote origin master at last tick. Drift from local_sha indicates an upstream update.

actions.description: Counts of each maintenance action the daemon has performed across all ticks.
